title: Anthropic · 更新日志来源更新
summary: 更新了水印支持范围，从图像视频扩展到音频，并新增企业端点指南，表明产品功能扩展。

pairs.before: Text generated by Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 carries Anthropic's text watermark, and supported image and video files that Claude produces through the code execution tool carry C2PA Content Credentials when you retrieve them through the Files API on the Claude API. Marking requires no changes to your requests or response handling.
pairs.after: Text generated by Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 carries Anthropic's text watermark, and supported image, video, and audio files that Claude produces through the code execution tool carry C2PA Content Credentials when you retrieve them through the Files API on the Claude API. Marking requires no changes to your requests or response handling.

added_lines: The guides for the Claude Enterprise endpoints of the Admin API (user management and spend limits), the Claude Enterprise Analytics API, and the Compliance API now show the anthropic-version header; send it on every request to these endpoints, as in the rest of the Claude API. See API versions.
